items.claim: Alistair Overeem is coming off of a two-week bender prior to his fight.
items.quote: He's coming off of a two-week bender here

items.claim: Alistair Overeem's opponent is a crafty veteran performing at a very high level at over 40 years old.
items.quote: against a crafty vet who's proven to be really good even later in his career. You know, he's not lost any of his real talent, obviously, but still he's still performing at a very high level at 40-plus years old.

items.claim: Uros Medic does not have an iron chin.
items.quote: it's not like he has an iron chin.

items.claim: D-Rod was able to clip and finish Uros Medic.
items.quote: If D-Rod chip chinned him and clipped him and got him out of there, I really would not be all that surprised.
